name: Restoration of Citizenship

requirements.blocker_text: Former Jamaican citizen (by birth, descent, adoption, registration, or naturalisation) who subsequently renounced Jamaican citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Form R5 (restoration application), submitted in triplicate
Proof of prior Jamaican citizenship and its renunciation
JMD 80,000 (filed in Jamaica) or USD 1,000 / CAD 1,100 / GBP 625 / EUR 700 (filed via a Jamaican diplomatic mission abroad)

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (PICA), Jamaica -- Restoration of Citizenship: for former Jamaican citizens (by birth, descent, adoption, registration, or naturalisation) who renounced citizenship and wish to reacquire it, Form R5 in triplicate, fees JMD 80,000 (local) or USD 1,000 / CAD 1,100 / GBP 625 / EUR 700 (via mission abroad)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- directly fetched by me from pica.gov.jm, tier-1. Applies only to people who THEMSELVES previously held and renounced Jamaican citizenship -- not a general-purpose ancestry route for descendants who never held citizenship (see jm_citizenship_by_descent.json for that). No generational cap or restriction found beyond the former-citizen requirement itself. Foreign fee is markedly higher than the local fee and scales by currency/mission rather than a flat conversion, sourced exactly as PICA states it.
